confirmed_anchor.what_it_means: ZEB1 high expression is a significant prognostic marker in bevacizumab-treated HGSOC. High ZEB1 = worse OS. Effect is real but not bevacizumab-specific (arm interaction not significant). This is the strongest validated signal in the EscapeMap to date.
confirmed_anchor.next_step: Formal interaction test in full ICON7 N=745 dataset (requires Roche data-sharing portal request) + TCGA-OV cross-validation

product_definition.what_EscapeMap_is: A computational pipeline that systematically tests candidate escape markers (ZEB1, SOX2, HIF1A, ABCB1, BCL2, VEGFC, MMP9, M2 macrophage programs) across treatment-annotated clinical trial datasets to identify which signals are associated with treatment resistance and poor outcomes
product_definition.current_output: One ANCHOR_CANDIDATE signal (ZEB1/OV/ICON7) + one PREPARATORY panel (M2-15/CRC) + three access-blocked lanes + one permanently closed lane
product_definition.clinical_utility_today: NONE — all signals are exploratory/hypothesis-generating; no validated predictive biomarker exists
path_to_product: 1. Send CTEP email → unlock phs003428 → validate M2-15 in CALGB80405 with individual outcomes
2. Submit Vivli DAR → unlock VELOUR/MOSAIC → test escape signatures in 2L CRC
3. Send Alliance outreach → unlock N0147 → test in adjuvant CRC with ctDNA + Immunoscore
4. Request Roche ICON7 full dataset (N=745) → run formal arm interaction test for ZEB1
5. Acquire Leeds/GLASS EGA dataset → test ZEB1/EMT in paired GBM RNA-seq at higher N
6. Analyze GSE174554 spatial transcriptomics → test subclonal EMT in GBM at spatial resolution
